Description: Who we are Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool. Today, we're a SaaS company and a trusted partner to over 155,000 hair, beauty and medspa professionals worldwide. Our all-in-one software and AI-driven tools help them manage bookings, take payments, market their services, grow their client base and get the best from their teams. Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive. We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that. The Opportunity We're looking for a Frontend Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at Phorest. You'll work alongside talented engineers, product managers and designers to build and improve the technology that powers thousands of salons, spas and MedSpas around the world. This is an opportunity to work on a large-scale SaaS platform, building intuitive, high-quality user experiences that make a real difference to the businesses that use Phorest every day. Our frontend technology stack includes Ember.js, JavaScript and Tailwind, alongside technologies such as GraphQL, Apollo and Node.js. We're looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, cares about the details and wants to continue developing their skills in a collaborative, supportive environment. You'll be part of a team that values clean code, practical solutions and continuous improvement, with the opportunity to contribute your ideas and help shape how we build our products. What You'll Do Design, build and maintain high-quality, responsive web applications that deliver a great user experience. Work closely with engineers, product managers and designers to turn requirements into well-designed, shippable features. Build reusable, maintainable UI components using modern JavaScript frameworks and our design system. Contribute to technical discussions and help make informed decisions about frontend architecture and implementation. Write clean, well-tested code, following engineering best practices. Develop automated unit and acceptance tests to ensure the quality and reliability of our software. Identify opportunities to improve application performance, accessibility and the overall user experience. Take ownership of your work from development through to deployment and ongoing improvement. Participate in code reviews, share knowledge and learn from other engineers. Stay curious about emerging frontend technologies and contribute ideas to improve how we work. Who You Are You have 5+ years of professional frontend development experience, working with Ember.js or another modern JavaScript framework such as React, Angular or Vue. You have a strong understanding of JavaScript, HTML and CSS, and experience building modern web applications. You're comfortable working with RESTful APIs, with GraphQL experience being a bonus. You have experience building responsive, reusable UI components and working with design systems. You understand the importance of code quality, testing, maintainability and performance. You can reason about technical trade-offs and contribute to discussions about frontend solutions. You enjoy collaborating with designers, product managers and other engineers to solve problems. You're proactive, take ownership of your work and aren't afraid to ask questions or share your ideas. You have a growth mindset, enjoy learning and are keen to continue developing your technical skills. You're a collaborative team player who values feedback, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. Benefits 🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service. 💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection. 🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets. 🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause. 🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits. 🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning. 🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days. Want to learn more about Phorest? Check out for our blog and Insights on building an evergreen company from the team here at Phorest. Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest! Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams. Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. Description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend The Opportunity: Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem. As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana. You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise. AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. What You’ll Be Doing: Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability. Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs. Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities. Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands. Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk. Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through. Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work. Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities. Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need. Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work. Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes. Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions. What Makes You a Great Fit Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly. A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers. A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands. Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes. Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation. An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams. Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively. Bonus Points For Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems. Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions. Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products. Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations. Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product. Compensation & Rewards: In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 117,949- GBP 141,539. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs ' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs : 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it. Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. Description: About Phorest Would you like to create the future of a product used by thousands of businesses and millions of consumers? Phorest Salon Software powers over 11,000 hair and beauty salons in Ireland, UK, Germany, Australia, Finland, USA, Canada, UAE and Netherlands and the platform processes 7 million appointments a month for hair and beauty consumers. Phorest is the number 1 salon software brand for premium independent salons in those markets and our next goal is to become a platform upon which other companies can build applications for premium salons. Our system touches every point of the salon experience. We have the in-salon software desktop application, Phorest Go (the native staff application), online bookings website for salons, and custom native apps per salon. In a typical month, Phorest processes 3 million appointments and we send over 3 million SMS and 4 million emails. We process 200k online bookings per month and over 150 custom built white label native apps. The Opportunity We are looking for a new Senior Software Frontend Engineer to join our Salon Ops Group. You will join a multidisciplinary group of technology, product, and design folks in building the future of the hair, beauty, and MedSpa industry. You will be a key member of our team, helping them to design and build the future of our multi-tenant SAAS platform to allow our customers to engage, attract, win and retain clients. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants a new challenge, where you’ll bring your experience to a supportive, growth-mindset environment that will enable us to achieve our goals. Within the Salon Ops group, you will be working together with a group of highly skilled engineers in building exciting new features. Your primary responsibilities will involve working with a modern Ember.js frontend stack. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to engage with GraphQL, Apollo, Node.js What You'll Do Push the boundaries of modern frontend development to build fast, ambitious web applications that will delight our clients. Collaborate closely with our product team to build features that have a significant business impact. Proactively identify bottlenecks and improve our frontend developer experience. Work with our design team to build elegant and intuitive UI components. Understand our business context deeply and leverage engineering knowledge to come up with creative solutions to problems. Thrive in a small, nimble team comprising technical experts. Prioritise quality and high standards by continually applying high coding standards, excellent attention to detail, and a methodological work process. Demonstrate and drive proper coding techniques, including maintainability, reuse, clean code, and unit testing within the team. Develop automated unit and acceptance tests to ensure software meets design criteria. Never stop learning; pursue the latest technologies, seek the best solutions, and always look to improve. Coach and help teammates through code reviews and whiteboarding sessions. Get involved at a team level in designing and implementing solutions. Challenge the norm and aren't afraid to voice their opinion. Who You Are Strong proficiency and at least 5 years of professional experience with Ember.js or any other modern JS Framework Knowledge and understanding of JavaScript, its fundamentals, and latest developments in JavaScript Experience in working with and building RESTful APIs (GraphQL a bonus) The ability to reason about trade-offs when discussing frontend technologies Ability to inspire and motivate, to improve quality and productivity, maintaining technical innovation and excellence Quality & high standards really matter to us - you will focus on continually applying high coding standards, excellent attention to detail and a methodological work process. Benefits 🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service. 💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection. 🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets. 🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause. 🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits. 🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning. 🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days. Want to learn more about Phorest? Check out for our blog and Insights on building an evergreen company from the team here at Phorest. Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest! Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalised folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit. Description: Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit . Team Description The Ad Formats team builds and evolves Reddit ’s ad experiences across all platforms and all format types, including image, video, carousel, shopping, etc. The team defines how those ads behave across placements like feed, conversation, search, making sure each format works in the right surfaces and contexts across Reddit . The team supports the end-to-end user ad experience, including media rendering, click behavior, special click variants like lead gen, and the UI details that make promoted content feel native to Reddit while optimizing for advertiser's goals. Within this area, the Ad Formats Foundation team owns the common infrastructure behind all ad formats, with a mission to improve developer efficiency, system reliability, and long-term scalability across the stack. We are responsible for modernizing core formats infrastructure, standardized format data, drive cross-platform consistency and compliance for ad formats to reduce bugs and allow the formats team to iterate quickly and improve the developer velocity. Our goal is to continuously improve ad formats infrastructure, with a focus on increasing developer efficiency and system reliability through tech stack modernization, scalability investments, and compliance work. Role Description We’re looking for a senior frontend engineer with deep JavaScript, TypeScript, and browser platform expertise to help strengthen Reddit ’s advertising experiences across desktop and mobile web. You will partner with product and design to work through ambiguous requirements and make sound product and engineering tradeoffs. You’ll work closely with Ads and Web Platform engineers to solve complex frontend challenges while maintaining site performance, accessibility, and a dependable user experience. This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys browser-level problem solving, navigating ambiguity, and building maintainable systems with measurable impact. Responsibilities Develop resilient frontend approaches to reduce ad disruptions, drawing on deep knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, the DOM, and browser networking. Partner with Ads and Web Platform teams to integrate solutions into shared rendering infrastructure, frontend architecture, and build systems. Design controlled experiments and phased rollouts to measure effectiveness while protecting site performance, accessibility, and user experience. Build instrumentation and monitoring to track mitigation effectiveness, detect regressions, and guide iteration. Implement ad rendering, event collection, click handling, browser extensions across multiple Ad formats. Contribute to broader foundational improvements in web advertising reliability, performance, and measurement. Raise engineering quality through thoughtful technical design, testing, code reviews, documentation, and mentorship. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience building production web applications with JavaScript, TypeScript, and/or React. Comfort using Codex, Cursor, Claude, or comparable agentic coding tools in day-to-day software development. A track record of independently delivering complex frontend projects from technical design through launch and iteration. Sound judgment in frontend architecture, state management, component design, testing, and API integration. Experience building polished user interfaces with close attention to usability, performance, accessibility, and maintainability. Ability to work effectively through ambiguous product and technical problems. Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering, product, design, and data disciplines. Experience using instrumentation, experimentation, or product metrics to understand and improve user experiences. A habit of improving engineering quality through code reviews, documentation, and technical mentorship. Bonus points Experience working with various ad formats (video ads, display ads, etc) Technologies used on the team include JavaScript, Typescript and React Modern frontend testing, experimentation, and observability tools Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k Match Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Reddit Global Days Off Generous paid Parental Leave Paid Volunteer time off #li-remote Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. Description: Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration. As a Senior Frontend Engineer, you will collaborate with team members, product owners, and key stakeholders to outline, develop, and deliver solutions that meet defined requirements. You will manage deliverables, timelines, and expectations for assigned projects and features. Your responsibility includes implementing code to enhance the user experience while adhering to best practices in security and reliability. You will deeply understand our product and business goals, staying up to date with our innovations and market trends to ensure an attractive, consistent, and highly functional UX. Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines. What you’ll do: Prioritize, design, develop, deploy, and operate secure, robust, scalable, and fast front-end web, mobile, and customer-facing solutions. Write clearly structured, maintainable, well-documented, and thoroughly tested code that aligns with our requirements and goals. The code should be of high enough quality to be open-sourced. Improve our global codebase through brainstorming sessions, code reviews, unit testing, automation, and participating in an on-call rotation. Translate complex customer requirements into actionable code for sprint pipelines while providing support and mentorship to peers. What we’re looking for: 4+ years of hands-on experience in a similar role. Strong domain knowledge of JavaScript for developing complex solutions, with expertise in frameworks like React. Proven experience in solution architecture and engineering, including requirements gathering, problem-solving, and recommendations. Communication, listening, and presentation skills with diverse audiences, along with experience in supporting and mentoring peers. Nice to Have: Experience with WebGL, WebWorkers, or other modern Web APIs. Familiarity with containerization platforms like Docker, Kubernetes (K8s), etc. Understanding of online security frameworks or annotation interfaces. What we offer: Fully remote position with flexible working hours. An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world. Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often. High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting edge R&D. Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams. We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online! Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence. Description: This is a frontend system engineering role focused on evolving Seeq ’s frontend React infrastructure, state management, design system, and building reusable application patterns for a complex enterprise product. You will shape not just UI primitives, but the broader frontend foundations that teams use to build clear, consistent, high-quality experiences across data-dense workflows. Passionate about crafting exceptional software, you revel in writing code with elegance, extensibility, and maintainability as your guiding principles. What You Will Do You will lead the evolution of Seeq ’s frontend system, improving component quality, consistency, usability, and developer experience across the product. You understand that AI is not only changing product interfaces but also how they are built. You have experience or are interested in building systems that set up AI-driven development for success by codifying best practices that are easy for agents to follow. You know how to leverage the best of the open-source ecosystem rather than building everything from scratch. You can leverage systems like Zustand, TanStack Query, and StyleX with taste and judgment, extending and adapting them where needed to fit Seeq ’s product, standards, and workflows. You will also help ensure that refactors to bring in new patterns or libraries are done with an exceptionally high bar for quality and completeness since these changes can have a far-reaching impact for the teams that use them. You’ll partner closely with the teams who rely on our infrastructure to roll out changes smoothly. What We’re Looking For You are an exceptional frontend engineer with strong product sense, visual taste, and systems thinking. You have real experience creating, evolving, and shipping design systems or component libraries used in production applications. You are highly effective in React and Typescript and have had exposure to some of the popular ecosystem libraries like Zustand, StyleX, or TanStack Query. You know how to build frontend systems that are composable, accessible, robust, and ergonomic for other engineers. You think carefully about component APIs, styling architecture, responsiveness, usability, and long-term maintainability. You understand and resolve the root causes for defects instead of patching the symptom. You collaborate effectively through code review, pairing, and clear communication. You are product- and user-focused — you engage with customers or other teams and can articulate the rationale behind features and pain points to your fellow engineers. You have strong written and verbal communication skills. You care about documentation and clear conventions as much as implementation quality. You can help others understand the rationale behind design decisions and create systems that teams can adopt effectively. You bring strong ownership and agency. You do not wait to be told where the gaps are. You find them, make good judgments about where to focus, and drive improvements through to completion. Description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations Our objective is to organise anyone's life. Role As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work. What You'll Own Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets. Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets. Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications. Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows. Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices. Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly. What We're Looking For Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces. Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details. Able to independently own features from technical design through production. Outcomes Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets. Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows. Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product. Interview Process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally. Description: Join the Tilt team At Tilt , we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide , we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward. About Blipay Blipay is Tilt 's Brazilian business unit. In Brazil, credit is still decided by a score that summarizes someone's past and ignores their present. We do it differently — using Open Finance and real-time financial signals, we look at people's actual financial lives and say yes to people the traditional market writes off too quickly. Over 1 million customers. Salary advance, FGTS, consignado. Products that put money in people's hands when they need it. The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend You'll build both sides of what our customers touch: the mobile app in React Native and our web surfaces in React and TypeScript. The codebase is consolidated, built on clean architecture and clear separation of concerns — and we're actively adding new products on top of it. That's the interesting part of this role: you're not maintaining something finished, you're extending a foundation that has to keep holding up as more lands on it. We're looking for someone who thinks about software scalability, not just screens. You'll work close to the product — no intermediary layer between you and the problem. You're part of the conversation about what to build, you build it, and you watch it reach production. Salary advance, FGTS, and consignado move money in people's lives every month, so what you ship has direct consequences for someone. This role is remote. The team gathers at our Campinas office twice a year, and as part of Tilt you'll join two global offsites annually — past locations include Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City. How You'll Make an Impact Build and evolve the mobile app in React Native and web products in React and TypeScript — owning your workstreams from design handoff through production Ship the interfaces behind salary advance, FGTS, and consignado — flows where clarity and correctness decide whether someone gets credit Extend a clean-architecture codebase as new products are added, keeping structure and separation of concerns intact as the surface area grows Work with APIs and the BFF layer to shape the contracts your screens depend on — enough backend fluency to know where logic belongs Collaborate directly with product, credit, compliance, and analytics; your technical perspective is part of the conversation, not downstream of it Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions in ways that make the work around you better Why You're a Great Fit 4+ years of combined frontend and mobile engineering experience — if you're close and the rest fits, let's talk Solid experience with React Native for mobile and React with TypeScript for web Hands-on experience with a state management library — we care that you've worked seriously with one, not which one Comfort with clean architecture and separation of concerns; an instinct for how software scales as products are added Working knowledge of backend and BFF concepts — enough to reason about API contracts and where logic belongs Fluent Portuguese and advanced English (C1) — collaboration with the broader Tilt team happens in English, written and spoken Comfortable using AI-powered development tools as a genuine productivity lever (we use Claude; similar experience transfers) Why Blipay CLT employment with full benefits — health insurance, VR/VA meal allowances, and a home office stipend. Competitive compensation and Tilt equity. Remote-first with a team spanning 14 countries and 12 time zones. Direct access to leadership — good ideas travel fast here, and growth follows contribution, not tenure. And twice a year, the whole company gets together in person somewhere worth going. Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you. What you'll get at Tilt Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement. Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity. Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards. Visibility is yours : You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly. Paid global onsites : Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.) Impact is recognized : Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines. The Tilt Way We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures. You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: We are looking for a Sr. Frontend Engineer to join the team of a retail company. In this role, you will be the team's go-to Frontend specialist, with the core objective of leading the complete revamp of the online store and optimizing the user shopping experience through strong A/B testing strategies and continuous UX improvements. You’ll lead the redesign and optimization of the online store—especially the checkout experience with a strong focus on improving UX, conversion rates, and overall performance. What do we require from you? +4 years of solid and proven experience developing with Shopify Liquid. Hands-on experience working with Shopify APIs and Shopify Themes. Strong proficiency in JavaScript. Proven experience implementing A/B tests to drive data-informed technical decisions. Strong background iterating on technical solutions based on performance and business metrics. Solid understanding of UX/UI optimization specifically aimed at Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO). Strong analytical capacity (solutioning) to solve uncommon technical problems and find efficient alternatives using the Shopify app ecosystem. High level of autonomy and independence to proactively lead Frontend development, taking full ownership of technical solutions. Advanced english level. Description: Welcome to Perena : Your Risk Layer on Solana Perena is a decentralized financial protocol on Solana that offers USD STAR (USD*), a yield-bearing asset. We're backed by some of the best in the world, including: Solana co-founders Anatoly Yakovenko and Raj Gokal Investors from Citadel, Jane Street, IMC, and Susquehanna Borderless Capital, Binance Labs, Primitive Ventures, Maelstrom, Anagram, Breed, and others Perena was a sponsor of the Colosseum Hackathon Stablecoin Track , helping fund the next generation of stablecoin projects on Solana. Our growing community spans over 20,000 developers, users, and builders aligned around one goal: reinventing how money works. What You'll Do Build and own the frontend applications that bring Perena 's financial products to life, from minting and redeeming USD* to portfolio dashboards, yield analytics, and on-chain transaction flows, using Next.js and TypeScript as the core stack Design and implement a scalable component library and design system that ensures consistency, accessibility, and reusability across all Perena surfaces, including public-facing apps, internal operations tools, and documentation Integrate directly with on-chain data and wallet infrastructure, building seamless interactions with Solana programs, wallet adapters, and real-time blockchain state to create intuitive user experiences around complex DeFi primitives Collaborate closely with protocol engineers, designers, and product to translate sophisticated financial concepts (yield strategies, collateral flows, risk metrics) into clear, trustworthy interfaces that inspire user confidence Own frontend performance, reliability, and observability, including optimizing load times, implementing error boundaries, building monitoring and analytics pipelines, and ensuring the app performs under real-world conditions across devices and regions Drive data-driven iteration by instrumenting user flows, analyzing engagement and conversion metrics, and shipping improvements that make Perena 's products easier and more compelling to use What We're Looking For 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong emphasis on Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript in production environments Deep understanding of React patterns, server components, client/server rendering strategies, caching, and data fetching in modern Next.js applications Experience building and maintaining component libraries or design systems testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E) and CI/CD pipelines to maintain quality at speed Comfort working with designers in Figma, translating visual specs into pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible implementations Familiarity with DeFi or fintech products is a strong signal, but not required. What matters is you can learn fast and reason about how users interact with money Earlier in your career? Description: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada. The Opportunity: Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise. The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts. This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope. What You’ll Be Doing: The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal. Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd. Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React) Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP) Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks What Makes You a Great Fit: At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe. We are seeking a Staff FullStack Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and user experience are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain. You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams. Some things you might be expected to do could include: Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code Designing new microservices or systems Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions Coordinating with product and UX when needed Responding to customer requests and feedback When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization Requirements: You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience You have worked on a big SaaS platform and dealt with common distributed systems problems (e.g. scalability, multi-tenancy, data isolation, HA, …) Strong professional experience with backend technologies (Golang, Node.js) as well as modern frontend web development (TypeScript, React) Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on Have some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, and brainstorming ideas to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way You write clean, robust, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain Have experience with mentoring junior engineers in a collaborative but asynchronous environment Can take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve tight learning loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively You are willing to work across teams. Your work has to be aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. You make your plans transparent, bring stakeholders on board, and are open to feedback and suggestions Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.) Bonus Points For: Experience with high-volume usage metering, billing engines, or customer-facing cost management applications Experience designing, building, and maintaining integrations with third-party business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Cloud Marketplaces) Experience with frontend component libraries, design systems, and modern CSS-in-JS tooling Familiarity with cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS provisioning/tenancy patterns Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch In the United States, the compensation range for this role is $174,986 - $209,983 USD. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that. Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts. About the Role: You are the technical owner of every pixel a Commerce merchant or shopper sees. You also raise the frontend bar for all of HighLevel . The role has two horizons. Commerce first. You set the architecture. You write the standards. You review the code. You hire the team. You hold the line on performance, accessibility, and quality while engineers and their coding agents ship into Commerce every day. Then HighLevel . Commerce is greenfield. That makes it the place to prove what excellent frontend engineering looks like at HighLevel . What works in Commerce becomes a shared capability, so every organization benefits. The central frontend platform team is your closest partner on both horizons. They own the shared foundation. You are their most demanding customer and one of their strongest contributors. You bring Commerce requirements early. You co-design solutions with them. You upstream what Commerce builds, so HighLevel keeps one foundation. This is an individual contributor role at staff level. You lead through design documents, code, reviews, and the people you grow. You will write production code every week. The bar is high. A storefront that loads in six seconds loses the sale. A checkout a screen reader cannot use excludes a customer and breaks the law in some markets. An architecture that couples every team slows every one of them. A pattern that stays inside one organization helps only that organization. You own all four problems. Responsibilities: First 90 days Publish the Commerce frontend standard: architecture, state, data fetching, testing, accessibility, and performance. Every Commerce team adopts it. Instrument real-user monitoring on every Commerce surface. Publish field metrics for LCP, INP, and CLS per surface, with an owning team for each. Review frontend pull requests across Commerce. Raise the quality of every one you touch, and write down the patterns so reviews scale beyond you. Map the central frontend platform roadmap against Commerce needs. Agree a working contract with that team: what the platform provides, what Commerce builds, and how requests and contributions flow both ways. Set up a standing design review with the central platform team, so Commerce decisions and platform decisions stay aligned. Produce a frontend hiring plan: how many engineers, at what levels, and in what order. First 6 months Ship the architecture that lets every Commerce team build and deploy its surfaces independently, with enforced module boundaries. Build it on the central platform's foundation wherever one exists, and close gaps jointly with that team. Put performance and bundle budgets in CI for every Commerce route. A regression fails the build. Make accessibility a gate: automated checks in CI and manual audits on checkout and storefront flows against WCAG 2.2 AA. Land typed, generated API clients end to end, so a backend contract change breaks at compile time. Contribute at least one Commerce-built capability to the central platform, adopted by another organization. Hire and onboard the first Commerce frontend engineers. First 12 months Commerce storefronts meet "good" Core Web Vitals at the 75th percentile in field data, on mid-range mobile devices. Checkout and storefront pass a WCAG 2.2 AA audit. Backend engineers ship frontend features that meet the standard without your direct involvement. Coding agents across Commerce follow the frontend standard by default, through shared instructions, skills, and review gates you designed. Commerce is HighLevel 's reference implementation for frontend excellence. Its standards, performance budgets, and agent guidance reach other organizations through the central platform. You lead or co-lead HighLevel -wide frontend decisions with the central platform team, written as RFCs other organizations build on. The Commerce frontend team runs on its own. You spend your time on the next hardest problem at HighLevel . Requirements: You have 9+ years of experience in building frontend systems You have built commerce surfaces at scale: storefronts, checkout, or point of sale. You have built or led a design system consumed by many teams, and shipped breaking changes through it safely. You have used ConnectRPC, gRPC-Web, or protocol buffers from the browser. You can read and write Go well enough to build or review a backend-for-frontend. You contribute to open source, web standards discussions, or the frontend community. You have taught backend engineers to ship good frontend code. You have contributed to a shared frontend platform or design system used by several product organizations. Our Stack & Direction Frontend. Vue.js across HighLevel . TanStack Query for server state. Webpack and Rspack for builds, with micro-frontends where teams need independent deploys. Contracts. ConnectRPC with protocol buffers from the browser to the backend. The client calls typed functions and receives typed responses. No hand-written REST clients. Backend. Go services on Kubernetes, with Postgres as the primary store. Backend-for-frontend layers run inside the cluster, close to the services they call. Rendering. Static generation where content allows it, client-side rendering for interactive surfaces, and a backend-for-frontend to aggregate data. You will challenge and refine this direction with evidence. Engineering practice. Every engineer works with coding agents. Standards live as written documents, shared agent instructions, and review gates. What you bring on day one: Scope. You have owned frontend architecture across several teams for a multi-quarter effort. Other teams still build on decisions you made. You can show us the before and after. Platform partnership. You have worked with a central platform team as both a consumer and a contributor. You influence roadmaps you do not own. You negotiate scope with evidence. You land changes in shared code that many organizations depend on, without breaking them. You have taken a standard from one team and made it company-wide. The browser platform. You know the rendering pipeline, the event loop, and what makes a long task. You follow new platform features through Baseline and MDN, and you have shipped some of them. You reach for the platform before a library, and you have deleted dependencies because the browser made them unnecessary. Performance. You diagnose with field data, performance traces, and network waterfalls. You have moved Core Web Vitals in production and kept them there with budgets and ownership. You can explain where every millisecond of a page load goes, from DNS to interaction. Architecture for many teams. You have designed systems where many teams deploy independently into one product. You know module federation, native ES modules, import maps, monorepos, and when each one fits. You know what each costs: duplicate dependencies, runtime integration bugs, build infrastructure. You pick deliberately. Data and contracts. You design how the client talks to the server: backend-for-frontend layers, typed RPC contracts, caching, and invalidation. You understand why twenty sequential calls over the public internet cost seconds, and how to collapse them. Accessibility. You build with semantic HTML first and add ARIA only where semantics fall short. You know WCAG 2.2, colour contrast requirements, and keyboard and screen reader behaviour. You have led an accessibility audit and fixed what it found. Security. You treat user-generated content as hostile. You know XSS, content security policy, sandboxed rendering, and supply chain risk in the npm ecosystem. Code review. Your reviews make engineers better. You find the race condition before the naming nit. You turn repeated feedback into lint rules, patterns, and documentation. AI-assisted engineering. You use coding agents every day with discipline. You write the context, specs, and skills that make agent output match the standard. You verify generated code with tests and review. You have a view on how teams keep a codebase understandable when everyone generates three times more code. Writing. This is a core platform role, not a feature role — you'll own the layer every other team builds on: the application shell, our module federation topology, the shared component library, build tooling, and the performance bar that applies across every surface of the product. You'll stay hands-on with code and architecture while setting technical direction across multiple teams and leading multi-quarter migrations without stalling feature delivery. Responsibilities: Failure Isolation: Design so a broken or slow remote degrades one surface, not the whole application — with fallbacks, timeouts, and the observability to identify which remote caused an incident. Release Strategy: Own the deployment and versioning story for independent releases, including contract testing across host/remote boundaries, staged rollout, and fast rollback of a single remote. Load Performance: Attack bundle size and dependency-graph bloat through code splitting, shared-chunk strategy across federated remotes, preloading/prefetching, and caching/CDN strategy. Runtime Performance: Attack main-thread cost through long-task analysis, reactivity and re-render cost, list virtualization, and memory leak diagnosis in long-lived sessions. You're the person engineers escalate production-only regressions and render thrash to. Performance Measurement: Define the metrics that matter (Core Web Vitals, INP, route transition time), instrument them in real-user monitoring, and enforce budgets in CI so regressions are caught before they ship. Quality Bar: Set and enforce accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), internationalization, and cross-browser support through automated checks, not documentation alone. Deep production experience with a modern component framework. Primarily Vue 3 (Composition API); strong React, Angular, or Svelte experience is welcome if you're willing to go deep on Vue. Hands-on production experience with micro-frontends or module federation, including the failure modes. Equivalent experience decomposing a large monolith by other means also considered. Proven track record optimizing large-scale, complex web applications. Be ready to walk through a specific example with numbers. Experience with modern build tooling at scale (Vite, Webpack, Rspack, Turborepo, or Nx), with enough depth to debug the build when it breaks. Working knowledge of accessibility as an engineering discipline — semantics, focus/keyboard behavior, ARIA where genuinely needed, screen reader testing. Strong written communication. On a remote-first, async team, most of your influence travels as design docs, RFCs, and PR descriptions. A track record of mentoring engineers and driving change across teams you don't manage. Nice to have: familiarity with Node.js, server-side rendering, and open-source contributions. The application shell and its contracts: bootstrapping, routing, auth-aware navigation, error and loading boundaries, and cross-application state. Our module federation topology: host and remote boundaries, shared dependency and singleton management, and version skew between independently deployed remotes. The shared component library and design system implementation, with APIs that are hard to misuse and safe to version. EEO Statement: The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. About the Project Purpose The Australian National Species List Website project will deliver high-quality online user interfaces to taxonomic and descriptive information about Australias unique plants, animals, fungi and other living things. Context Background: The Australian National Species List (auNSL) provides an authoritative source of information about the naming and classification of Australias unique plants, animals, fungi and other living things. The auNSL is a key resource supporting the management and conservation of, and research on, Australias biodiversity. Data from the auNSL supports a range of national biodiversity data infrastructures including the Atlas of Living Australia, the Terrestrial Ecosystem Research Network, and the Biodiversity Data Repository. Assumptions: The software developer will work with the Biodiversity Informatics team under the direction of the team manager. The user-interface will be built using a suitable frontend framework (e.g. React, Next.js, Vue.js, Rails etc) and containerised for deployment (ECS, Fargate). auNSL data will be integrated into the frontend via the GraphQL and REST APIs. An open-source headless CMS (e.g. strapi) will be implemented for descriptive information and other display assets to be used on the webpages. At the end of the engagement the Biodiversity Informatics team will be able to take on the further development and maintenance of the delivered infrastructure. Scope: The software developer will contribute to building the frontend to the Australian National Species List and implementing a headless CMS and API integration for search and data services. Constraints: The user interface must meet the Digital Transformation Agencys Digital Service Standard including for accessibility, security, and quality. To put people on the path to success, we nurture a culture built on trust, collaboration, and personal growth. Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you. your competencies YOUR PROFILE Mindset Is your goal to deliver great software, whether the problem is easy or hard? Do you push deeper than most to find the right solution, not just the first one that works? Then you are the person we need. Responsibility You own what you build, all the way through, not just until it ships and becomes someone else's problem. The parts that go smoothly and the parts that get messy are both yours to see through. You bring your ideas, experience and your curiosity, you use AI to build better and faster, and you stand behind what you put your name on. Drive You will not know everything yet, and that is fine. What we cannot teach is drive. We bring the tools and the guidance. You bring the push to grow fast, understand what you build, and keep reaching past what you know. What you bring to the table: You work across crafts, not in a corner. You are close with developers, designers, and strategists, and you would rather build in the open than behind a wall. You make the team better. You speak up when something can be sharper, and you share what you learn instead of sitting on it. You care whether the client wins. You focus on the quality of the product and the experience, not just the ticket in front of you. what you can look forward to What you will actually do: We build complex, end-to-end products for both big-name and niche clients. You will own the frontend side of that work, plus the wider circle around it. You run most of it on your own, with a foundation solid enough to pick up whatever the project throws at you, fast. Day to day, that means: Owning features end to end: states, edge cases, accessibility, performance, not just the happy path. Taking medium and larger pieces on your own, and pairing with seniors on the architecture-level calls. Being a real team member and pushing past that: taking on things that stretch you, presenting your work to the client, and steering thin slices on your own. You’re enjoying being part of a team, not a remote desk which prefers to work in isolation most of the time. The tech stack you will work with: Languages and frameworks: React, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS APIs: REST and GraphQL Cloud: AWS, GCP Delivery: Existing CI/CD usage and maintenance AI tooling: Claude, Cursor, Pi, Antigravity, plus your and our own Skills and MCP setup Who you will work with We are a bunch of colleagues originally from similar backgrounds who got tired of how things were usually done and set out to find better ways. That is the whole reason this company exists, and it is still what we are doing. We are not a place of rockstars and egos. People here ask questions out loud, show rough work without flinching, and would rather help each other get something right than look clever alone. We push each other, in the good way, and we do not take ourselves too seriously while we are at it. You would be joining that. You’ll work closely with the crafts, designers and strategists, and just as easily with the people steering the projects and the business. There is no wall between you and any of it. Take on the parts you are ready for, and when you want more, a pitch, a client conversation, a bigger call, speak up at the right moment and the door is open. Smaller team. More ownership. Description: Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility. As a Microsoft Partner with nine specializations, GitHub AI Partner of the Year, a member of the GitHub Advisory Board, and a member of the prestigious Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), Atmosera expertly delivers cutting-edge, integrated solutions that deliver business value. You are joining us as a front-end web developer who will own and evolve the user interfaces for our internal tools. Alongside that primary focus, you will grow into full ownership of our Power BI reporting, building on solid, hands-on Power BI experience to take on report and dashboard delivery. Your day-to-day will involve building and improving user interfaces first and foremost, while growing into ownership of our Power BI reports, dashboards, and report-deployment process — all aimed at making our internal tools more usable and our reporting reliable, consistent, and easy to maintain. Required Skills • Years of Experience — 5+ years of experience • Role-Specific Mastery — Strong, hands-on front-end web development skills (React or similar) as your primary craft, complemented by solid, hands-on Power BI experience — enough to take on full ownership of report and dashboard delivery. • Operational Excellence — Working knowledge of the Power BI data layer (semantic models, DAX, Power Query/M) and SQL, with comfort learning and eventually owning an existing Python-based deployment/automation codebase. • Communication — Strong written and spoken English, with the fluency to collaborate clearly with technical, non-technical, and client-facing colleagues. • Collaboration — Experience partnering with engineers and cross-functional or client-facing teams to make sure the right data is surfaced in the right way, and comfort taking over and improving an inherited platform rather than only building from scratch. • Problem Solving — A strong eye for design and usability, and the judgment to improve the robustness of an existing deployment process by reducing brittle, manual steps. Preferred Qualifications • Power BI Projects (PBIP) — Experience with Power BI Projects and TMDL semantic-model definitions. • Power Platform — Experience with the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate). • Design Tooling — Experience with design systems, component libraries, or UX tooling (e.g., Figma) to keep interfaces consistent and polished. • Azure Ecosystem — Familiarity with Azure Resource Graph, Log Analytics/KQL, and Microsoft Sentinel. What Success Looks Like We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a "win" for this role over your first year: After 90 Days • The Foundation — You have developed a strong understanding of the existing front-end codebase, and are already building and updating individual Power BI reports yourself as part of your onboarding. • The Integration — You have built working relationships with Engineering and with the client-facing teams who rely on your reporting output, and are fielding Power BI requests directly. • The Contribution — You have independently delivered several Power BI report or dashboard updates, and shipped your first UI improvement. After 1 Year • Your Impact — You have taken full ownership of Power BI reporting — including report delivery and the report-deployment process — while also shipping measurable improvements to our internal tools' UI. • Your Growth — You have become the team's go-to owner for Power BI reporting and a strong, independent contributor on the front-end codebase. • Your Influence — You have defined and documented standard measures, naming conventions, and templates that made reporting consistent across programs and clients, and helped shape a new internal configuration-management interface from the ground up. How We Show Up These 'Core Three' represent the heartbeat of Atmosera . They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best. • Humble (Low Ego, High Impact) — We share credit easily, admit when we're wrong, and view every mistake as a data point for growth. • Hungry (Internal Drive) — We have a natural bias for action. We don't wait for permission to solve a problem or find a better way to do things. • Mindful (Intentional Awareness) — We are conscious of our impact on the team. We listen more than we speak and respond to challenges with empathy and situational awareness. Our Interview Process We value your time and aim for transparency. Our typical interview process looks like this: 1. Talent Screen: (30 mins) A conversation about your background and the role mission. 2. The Impact & Attributes Assessment: (60 mins) The "What" (Required Skills and Core Capabilities). This stage will require a Live coding challenge. 3. Collaborator Loop: (45 mins) The "How" (Cultural DNA and The Core Three). Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: The Company At Spartan Investment Group our mission is to improve lives through our values. We do this by finding value-add and opportunistic investments offering solid returns to our investors. Providing an opportunity to grow for our partners and creating lasting wealth for everyone with whom we conduct business is how we make our greatest contribution.
