We are members of the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America and in 2023 we were #13 in Denver Business Journals list of top places to work. Mission As the Senior BI & Front-End Developer, your mission is to transform complex business data into accurate, intuitive, and actionable dashboard experiences that help Spartan Investment Group teams understand performance and make informed decisions. You will own the full dashboard lifecycle, from requirements discovery and KPI definition through UX/UI design, development, validation, deployment, and continuous improvement across Apache Superset, Power BI, Tableau, and embedded web applications. Success means delivering polished, reliable, and user-centered BI solutions that make critical information easier to understand, reduce manual reporting, and enable teams to take action with confidence. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Business Intelligence Delivery: Measures the effectiveness of delivering BI solutions that address business needs, support decision-making, and provide stakeholders with meaningful, actionable information. Data Accuracy & Reliability: Measures the quality, consistency, and trustworthiness of dashboard data, calculations, metrics, and reporting outputs. User Experience & Adoption: Measures how effectively dashboards and data experiences support intuitive navigation, clear understanding, meaningful exploration, and ongoing stakeholder use. Reporting Efficiency: Measures the effectiveness of BI solutions in simplifying reporting processes, reducing manual effort, and improving access to business information. BI Standards & Scalability: Measures the consistency, maintainability, and scalability of dashboards, metric definitions, visualization practices, documentation, and reusable BI solutions. Outcomes Deliver Dashboard Projects: Own dashboard projects from requirements gathering and data exploration through design, development, testing, deployment, and documentation, with 90%+ delivered within agreed-upon timelines and scope. Ensure Data Accuracy: Build and maintain reliable dashboards across Apache Superset, Power BI, and Tableau, achieving 98%+ accuracy across validated metrics, calculations, filters, and reporting outputs. Create Effective User Experiences: Design intuitive, accessible dashboards that make key information easy to understand, explore, and act on, achieving 85%+ positive stakeholder feedback on usability and usefulness for new or significantly redesigned dashboards. Standardize KPIs & Business Rules: Partner with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, KPIs, calculations, and business rules, maintaining documented definitions for 100% of production KPIs and critical metrics owned by the role. Deliver Embedded Dashboard Experiences: Design dashboards that integrate naturally with existing web applications, navigation, branding, and user workflows, with 100% of releases completing functional, usability, and integration testing prior to deployment. Improve Reporting Efficiency: Automate or consolidate recurring reports, spreadsheets, and manual analyses, completing at least one measurable reporting-efficiency improvement per quarter based on time saved, processes automated, or manual work reduced. Maintain BI Standards: Build and maintain reusable templates, visualization standards, QA practices, and documentation, achieving 90%+ adherence to established BI design, documentation, and quality standards. Drive Continuous Improvement: Use stakeholder feedback, usage data, and emerging tools to complete at least one meaningful BI or dashboard improvement per quarter. Leverage AI where appropriate while ensuring 100% of AI-assisted production outputs are validated before release. Competencies Ownership: Takes responsibility for projects from discovery through delivery, works independently, follows through on commitments, and proactively raises risks or blockers. Analytical Thinking: Approaches complex business questions logically, evaluates data critically, identifies patterns and discrepancies, and uses evidence to inform decisions. User Focus: Designs with the end user in mind, prioritizing clarity, usability, accessibility, and the ability to quickly understand and act on information. Communication: Clearly communicates technical concepts, analytical findings, requirements, and design decisions to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Collaboration: Works effectively across business, data, and development teams, seeks input early, contributes constructively, and incorporates relevant feedback into solutions. Adaptability: Responds effectively to changing requirements, new information, evolving technology, and stakeholder feedback while maintaining quality and forward progress. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related technical field. 5+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence, dashboard development, data visualization, data analysis, or business analysis. Advanced experience with Apache Superset, including datasets, reusable metrics, dashboard development, filters, permissions, and performance optimization. Strong experience with Power BI and Tableau, including data modeling, interactive reporting, dashboard development, and performance optimization. Advanced SQL skills and practical experience with GCP, BigQuery, or comparable cloud analytics environments. Strong UX/UI and data visualization expertise, including information architecture, visual hierarchy, interaction design, accessibility, and visualization selection. Experience designing embedded dashboards and data-rich web experiences within established navigation, branding, and design systems. Proficiency with Figma or comparable design/prototyping tools for wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and design specifications. Demonstrated business analysis experience, including requirements discovery, KPI definition, business rules, and translating business needs into analytical solutions. Portfolio required demonstrating dashboard design quality, analytical reasoning, technical execution, and individual contributions. Remote Work Requirements Dedicated home office or professional remote work environment. Reliable high-speed internet connection capable of supporting video conferencing and daily business operations. Description: About Virtualitics Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty — giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here. Our team is excited to find our next Senior Frontend Engineer to join the company. As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Virtualitics , you will own the frontend of our next-generation application platform: the shared app shell, component library, hooks, and typed API client that every customer project team builds their product on. You will design the component APIs other engineers reach for first, decide how the platform handles auth, layout, theming, data fetching, and real-time updates, and keep all of it fast, accessible, and secure enough for defense networks. You will work alongside backend, AI, and DevSecOps engineers, and with the project teams shipping to defense and government customers. This is a chance to shape how a platform looks and behaves before it hardens, and to see your work in front of analysts and decision-makers within weeks. Our frontend is React and TypeScript, built with modern tooling and shipped as versioned packages that project teams build on. We use Material UI alongside an in-house design system, and most of what we build is data-heavy: large tables, interactive charts, dashboards, and streaming, chat-driven experiences. Treat accessibility (Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA) and classification-aware UI (banners, markings) as first-class requirements. Partner with backend engineers on API shape, auth and session behavior, real-time event contracts, and the security posture of the browser surface (CSP, cookies, dependency hygiene). Support project teams adopting the platform: review their frontend code, unblock them, and pull recurring patterns back into the shared packages. Help plan and execute the migration of our existing product frontend onto the new platform without pausing feature delivery. Mentor engineers and raise the standard for frontend work across the company. Experience owning a shared component library, design system, or frontend platform consumed by other teams, including package publishing, versioning, and breaking-change management. Fluency with the build and tooling layer: Vite, pnpm workspaces, ESLint, TypeScript project configuration, and CI for frontend packages. Experience shipping frontend tests that catch real regressions (Vitest or Jest with Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress). Experience building data-dense UIs: large tables with server-side pagination, interactive charts, dashboards. Working knowledge of browser security: session cookies, CSP, XSS, CSRF, and dependency supply chain. Clear written communication. Experience with streaming UIs (Server-Sent Events, WebSockets) or generative / LLM-driven interfaces. Description: Forloop.ai is looking for a Lead Front‌ End‌ developer. You will get an unique opportunity to play a key role from an early-stage in forming the product, the chosen tech stack, its roadmap, and help shape the team behind it. You will partner with the Founding team to help develop the product from beta stage through public launch and beyond. Your main focus will be on building of our unique drag-and-drop application. We see that you excel in taking responsibility both from a technical and team aspect, and thrive in seeing the results. This is a key role for the company - you should enjoy the thrill of taking initiatives that drive forward the product, the team, and the company as a whole. We do not value experience over talent and drive to develop. So even if it is a senior lead position, we are open for other applicants as well that can see this as a way to take the next step. OUR PREFERRED STACK Tech stack: Javascript, React.js framework, CSS, HTML, Typescript (nice to have) Libraries: React, Redux, React-router, Reselect, Redux-saga, Styled-components, Material UI, Ant Design, i18next, Webpack, Redux Form, Axios Drag-and-drop libraries (nice to have): React-dnd, React-draggable, React-digraph, or something better :) Testing: Cypress.io Error tracking, monitoring: Sentry.io Backend (will not be your responsibility but if you know some of these it‘s a plus) Python, Flask, Python ML Libraries, ETLs, SQL UI/UX/Product (nice to have): Figma, Adobe Xd, Material design, Bootstrap WHAT ELSE SHOULD YOU HAVE? University degree (or any comparable past experience) Extended experience with front end technologies Version control – Git Interest in new front end trends and technologies Experience with REST API Clean code best practices Analytical mind, Be a team player Reliability and enthusiasm towards new challenges English language at a sufficient level – we are international team Startup environment experience. (nice to have) Understanding of data problems or data science domain (nice to have) Awareness of Data Science products. (nice to have) WHY US? We are quite a new startup (started at the end of 2020) with a potential and global ambition to change the way data science is currently done and you can be the part of the mission. We are based in Stockholm and Prague and we build a company based on values like being remote friendly, inclusive, and international. We have also secured a fresh funding from a Berlin-based investor fund. Come and help us changing the data science world. OTHER PERKS: Have a key role and impact the direction of the company. Personal and career development with having a leadership role in a heavily technical product, with a talented and ambitious team, in a dynamic and fast growing market. Chance to manage and lead an engineering team. A fun, friendly, and collaborative environment A competitive salary and a possibility to participate in our attractive stock options plan Work from anywhere. Forloop.ai is a Swedish-Czech startup founded on the ambition to solve the problem that most (87%) of machine-learning projects never make it to production. Largely due to time, effort and complexity to handle data and data pipelines for ML. To solve that - Forloop.ai provides an easy-to-use data pipeline and preparation tool, with personalised intelligent recommendations. Forloop.ai is a tool for Data Scientists to accelerate the mundane, yet critical tasks, of turning source data into model ready data. Ultimately, Forloop.ai enables Data Scientists to focus on the creative aspects of data that drive the business forward. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design. We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building clean, performant interfaces and knows their way around a CMS well enough to make the backend work for the frontend, not against it. You'll spend most of your time in HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript — building custom Gutenberg blocks, theming, and pixel-perfect implementations from design mockups — while staying comfortable enough in PHP and WordPress/Drupal internals to troubleshoot, extend, and integrate when needed. You'll work directly with our design and consulting teams to turn mockups into fast, accessible, well-crafted websites for clients across a range of industries. What You'll Do Build custom WordPress themes, Gutenberg blocks (ACF or React-based), and plugins from provided designs Translate mockups into responsive, accessible frontend code using HTML, CSS/SASS, and modern JavaScript Work within Drupal for client sites that require it — theming, content types, and module-level troubleshooting Diagnose and fix frontend and backend issues across a variety of CMS platforms Collaborate directly with designers, consultants, and occasionally clients to solve problems and refine implementations Use AI tools like Claude Code to plan out and execute aspects of a large project. What You Bring Must-haves 5+ years of professional frontend development — strong HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript fundamentals 3+ years building and customizing WordPress sites, including Gutenberg block development (ACF or React-based blocks) Solid working knowledge of PHP (7.x/8.x) — enough to read, debug, and extend WordPress/Drupal codebases confidently Practical Drupal experience — theming, content architecture, or module-level work Familiarity with WordPress hooks/filters and general LAMP-stack conventions (MySQL, Git) Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating in a remote, client-facing environment Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Code. Nice-to-haves Experience with React or Angular Laravel or Symfony Docker and Linux environment familiarity AWS or other cloud platform exposure Why Brafton 100% remote, full-time role with a US-based team lead and a genuinely collaborative, cross-office culture spanning five countries. Description: About the Job AOA is hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build polished, high-performing web experiences for ambitious eCommerce and SaaS clients. You will turn thoughtful designs and product direction into production-ready interfaces, bringing the care, judgment, and craft that make digital products reliable and easy to love. This is a senior role for someone who enjoys ownership, but not isolation. We keep specifications lean because we trust strong engineers to think deeply, ask good questions, and shape the technical path forward. You will break product-level goals into clear engineering work, make sound implementation decisions, and bring the details a great frontend needs. You will work across a portfolio of client projects, partnering with designers, product leads, backend engineers, and client-facing teammates to move work forward with clarity and care. As an AI-native agency, we use modern AI coding tools and agents to increase speed, quality, and focus, while keeping strong human judgment at the center of the final product. You may be a strong fit if you are a senior frontend engineer who takes pride in excellent user interfaces, enjoys turning ambiguity into thoughtful implementation, communicates clearly, and wants to do high-quality work with a close-knit team that cares deeply about client outcomes. Role Details Compensation: $5,000 USD per month Engagement: Contract (independent contractor) Location: Remote, based in Latin America Schedule: Available during standard business hours in US Central Time, for strong overlap with the team Reports to: Engineering Manager About AOA AOA is a growing digital design and development agency that creates high-impact websites, AI-native apps, and standout eCommerce experiences for ambitious modern brands. We partner closely with eCommerce and SaaS companies to deliver thoughtful, polished work that drives meaningful results and lasting client success. Our work spans strategy, design, development, eCommerce, conversion optimization, and custom application development. We are a close-knit team where every person has a direct, visible impact on our clients' success and the growth of the company. We value genuine relationships, high standards, ownership, clear communication, and a true commitment to client delight. As an AI-native agency, we use modern tools to enhance the quality, speed, and clarity of our work, while keeping human judgment, creativity, and relationships at the center. Responsibilities Key Outcome: Deliver high-quality, high-performing frontend experiences that AOA is known for, with predictability, agentic-efficiency, and collaborative ownership. Build production-grade frontend experiences for enterprise accounts in React and Next.js. Write clear technical documentation, schemas, and architectural flows teammates can use. Turn product-level objectives into clear, actionable engineering tasks and own the technical approach. Translate Figma designs into reusable component libraries and design-system primitives that help the team ship faster. Bring frontend craft from the start and build for performance by default. Connect interfaces to backend and third-party APIs, handling loading, errors, empty states, and partial data. Plan and sequence your work across multiple client projects, bringing recommendations rather than open-ended problems. Proactively identify risks and gaps, and create spike tickets to de-risk them ahead of the work. Write tested, maintainable TypeScript that follows each client codebase’s conventions. Self-review your work and catch issues before QA. Conduct code reviews and hold the bar on quality across the work you review. Use AI coding tools and agents thoughtfully while keeping engineering judgment in control. Self-manage and take ownership of your commitments and deliver what you planned for the cycle. Communicate proactively across a remote team, sharing progress and surfacing risks early. Qualifications 5+ years building production frontend applications, with deep, current React expertise. Strong experience on enterprise-grade accounts, products, or projects. Prior experience working in an agency environment and as an independent contractor, with the ability to manage multiple clients or projects in parallel. Excellent professional English, spoken and written. A track record of owning frontend features end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to production. Strong frontend fundamentals: semantic HTML, modern CSS, responsive design, and browser behavior. Experience translating Figma designs into accurate, responsive, accessible interfaces. Experience integrating REST or GraphQL APIs and managing client and server state. A strong quality discipline: typed, tested code and self-review before QA. Ability to estimate your work, commit within a delivery cycle, and reliably deliver. Strong written communication and proactive, independent work in a fully remote team. Reliable overlap with standard US Central Time business hours. Fluent, practical use of AI coding tools as part of your engineering workflow. Based in Latin America and able to work as an independent contractor. Preferred Qualifications Experience with headless or eCommerce frontends, such as Shopify Hydrogen or headless commerce, in addition to SaaS. Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library used across multiple products. Familiarity with frontend testing and CI tooling, such as Playwright, Vitest or Jest, and Testing Library. Experience working in a points-based or sprint-based delivery model. A portfolio, GitHub, or code samples you can share. You do not need to check every single box to apply. We know strong engineers bring the right experience in different ways. If you build excellent frontends in React, take real ownership of your work, and want to do it at AI-native speed, we would love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: Role: Frontend Lead Alokai As an Alokai Frontend Lead , you will collaborate with Product and Delivery Managers to architect and build highly scalable, performant applications. This role demands strong leadership and development skills, including facilitating change, driving design excellence, upholding code quality standards, and striving for continuous improvement. You will play a key role in shaping the technology choices for the program and ensuring a world-class customer experience. Technology Landscape & Experience Required Expertise 10+ years of experience in implementing large-scale, multi-country, multi-language eCommerce B2C websites , with strong expertise in JavaScript and hands-on experience in React and Next.js . Proven ability to define frontend architecture and design, with experience integrating eCommerce as a backend engine. Leadership experience in Headless Commerce implementation projects across all SDLC phases. Strong knowledge of Composable Commerce Stacks and foundational understanding of platforms like Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) or Commercetools . Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and guide a team of developers (onshore and offshore), providing technical and architectural guidance. Conduct code reviews to ensure high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code. Utilize Sonar for code quality analysis and maintain adherence to best practices. Deliver presentations, architectural blueprints, development policies, and documentation for technical solutions. Drive best practices for design, coding, environment setup, and data management. Translate business requirements into technical tasks, ensuring alignment with non-functional requirements like performance, security, and scalability. Partner with Product Managers, Business Stakeholders, and Analysts to understand and solutionize customer requirements and process flows. Oversee the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration. Build Proofs-of-Concept (POC) to demonstrate potential technical solutions. Establish development patterns, DevOps processes, and technical standards for teams. Manage application architecture artifacts and continuously rationalize and simplify the user experience. Troubleshoot and optimize for SEO , SSR , page performance, and accessibility (WCAG compliance). Skills & Qualifications Expert knowledge of HTML5 , CSS (including preprocessors like LESS/SASS), and frameworks like Tailwind CSS . Proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with advanced knowledge of frameworks such as React and Next.js . In-depth understanding of headless architecture and platform-specific implementations (e.g., SFCC , Magento ). Experience with headless CMS platforms like Builder.io or Contentful . Proficiency in code reviews , maintaining high standards of quality, and adherence to coding best practices. Familiarity with Sonar or similar tools for code quality, static analysis, and technical debt management. Knowledge of API integrations, asynchronous requests, and debugging tools for partial page updates. Strong grasp of command-line build utilities (e.g., npm, Webpack) and version control systems like Bitbucket. Expertise in delivering standard, compliant, and accessible solutions. Experience with SEO optimization , SSR , and page performance troubleshooting. Familiarity with common design patterns and development methodologies. Fluent in English with excellent communication and documentation skills. A strong eye for scope management, with sound judgment and a pragmatic approach to scope, budget, and timeline challenges. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware .com. Job Description: Software Engineer I, JustPerform About the Role We are looking for a Software Engineer I to join the JustPerform product team. JustPerform is an enterprise software product in the financial performance management space, supporting workflows in areas such as financial planning, analysis, and financial close. You will work across the full stack, building features on a Vue 3 frontend and a Spring Boot backend, for customers who operate in complex, high-stakes financial environments. This is a role for someone who is past the learning curve of the basics and ready to take on meaningful feature work independently. You will be expected to contribute across both frontend and backend, write code that your teammates are happy to review, and bring a genuine curiosity about how modern tools, including AI, can make you a better engineer. What You'll Do Feature development Build and maintain full-stack features across the Vue 3 frontend and Spring Boot backend, working from well-defined requirements through to production. Write clean, well-structured code with appropriate test coverage, and participate actively in code reviews on both sides of the stack. Collaborate with product managers and designers to understand requirements, ask the right questions, and flag technical constraints early. Debug and resolve issues across the stack, taking ownership of a problem until it is properly resolved rather than passing it along. Contribute to technical discussions, design sessions, and sprint planning with a constructive point of view. Frontend engineering (Vue 3) Build UI components and features using Vue 3 with the Composition API, with attention to performance, reusability, and maintainability. Manage application state using Pinia, keeping data flows predictable and easy to reason about. Integrate frontend components cleanly with backend APIs, handling async data flows, loading states, and error scenarios correctly. Write TypeScript across the frontend codebase, maintaining type safety and consistency with established patterns. Write component-level tests using Vitest, and contribute to frontend quality standards across the team. Backend engineering (Spring Boot) Design and implement REST APIs using Spring Boot, following established patterns for structure, validation, and error handling. Work with relational databases: write efficient queries, understand indexing basics, and contribute to schema changes with appropriate migrations. Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and standard Spring testing utilities, maintaining meaningful coverage on the code you ship. Participate in backend code reviews and contribute to improving the quality and consistency of backend code over time. Learn and apply the team's existing patterns for authentication, authorization, and service-layer design as you contribute to new features. AI-assisted development Use AI coding tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude) as a regular part of your development workflow to write, review, and improve code more efficiently. Bring a thoughtful approach to AI-assisted development: know when suggestions are good, when they need revision, and when to discard them entirely. Experiment with AI tooling beyond basic code completion, such as using agents or custom skills to automate repetitive development tasks, generate test scaffolding, or accelerate documentation. Share what you learn about effective AI tooling with your team, contributing to a culture where the team improves its use of these tools over time. What We're Looking For Required 3 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience in a full-stack or backend-leaning role. Solid hands-on experience with Vue 3 using the Composition API; you have built real features with it, not just followed tutorials. Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot, building and maintaining REST APIs in a production environment. Working knowledge of relational databases: writing queries, understanding joins and indexes, and contributing to schema design. Familiarity with TypeScript in a frontend codebase; comfortable with types, interfaces, and generics at a working level. Experience writing tests across the stack: Vitest for Vue 3 component and unit testing on the frontend, JUnit for unit and integration testing on the backend. Experience with Pinia for state management in Vue 3 applications. Familiarity with Git workflows in a team environment: branching, pull requests, code review, and resolving conflicts. Awareness and hands-on experimentation with AI coding tools; you have used them in your own workflow and formed a view on where they help. Clear communication: able to ask good questions, articulate what you are working on, and flag blockers early rather than late. Nice to Have Experience working on enterprise software, particularly in finance, ERP, or performance management domains. Exposure to custom AI agents or workflow automation tools beyond basic code completion. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and containerised environments (Docker, GitHub Actions). Knowledge of Spring Security or similar frameworks for authentication and authorization. Experience with agile delivery practices including sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Who Thrives in This Role The right person for this role is comfortable on both sides of the stack and does not wait to be told exactly what to do. They take ownership of a piece of work, figure out what they need to know, and see it through. They are not the loudest person in the room, but they contribute meaningfully in design discussions and code reviews, and their teammates notice when they are not around. They are genuinely curious about AI tooling, not because it is expected of them, but because they have already found it useful and want to keep pushing. They have experimented beyond the basics and can talk concretely about where AI made them faster and where it led them astray. If you are someone who cares about the quality of your code, takes pride in shipping things that work well, and is looking for a product where the domain is complex enough to keep you learning, this is a good fit. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you lead the team that investigates and fixes it. Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters. You write code, review designs, and hold the highest standards. Engineers respect a lead who understands the work, not one who manages it from a distance You build strength across the team. You know when to be hands-on and when to step back. You lead with depth and raise the others up, rather than being the single point of failure You own it. You take responsibility for the team's delivery, quality, and production reliability — not just your own output. When something breaks, you lead the investigation and fix You develop people. You invest time in mentoring and growing the team, and you can point to engineers who are better for having worked with you You're direct and honest. Description: Senior Frontend Engineer Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time About Us Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $50 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 40+ of the world's leading liquidity providers. We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems. The Role We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role — our Frontend team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it. Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters. What You'll Work On Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional What We Need Technical: Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years) Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) Working knowledge of Rust , or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols) Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus Git and Linux fundamentals Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential How you work: You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn What You Get Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work. We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable. Description: About Us At Prenuvo , we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again". We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer I to join our eCommerce team, building the online booking experience patients use to choose a scan, find a clinic, pay, and schedule their appointment. You'll lead complex features in a Next.js and TypeScript application that serves customers in multiple countries, on flows where every screen directly affects conversion, revenue, and patient trust: product selection, checkout and payments, appointment scheduling across timezones, and our sales-assisted and partner booking paths. This is a high-impact role for someone who cares about the craft of the UI and about whether it actually works in production for every customer. If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems and owning outcomes rather than tickets, we'd love to hear from you. This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future). Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives! What You’ll Do Own features and components within an area of the booking experience, such as checkout and payments, scheduling, or the sales-assisted and partner flows, growing toward owning the area end to end. Work with Product and Marketing on growth: ship experiments on the booking funnel, then read the results honestly, including sample size, guardrail metrics, and whether a change is a real win or just noise. Build fast, accessible, customer-facing features with React, Next.js (App Router), and TypeScript. Contribute to frontend architecture and design, writing proposals you review with senior engineers: sensible server and client component boundaries, server state with TanStack Query, client state with Zustand, and type-safe forms with React Hook Form and Zod. Integrate the booking experience with our commerce APIs and third-party services, including Stripe, Affirm, commercetools, Voucherify, Salesforce, Auth0, and Google Maps. Instrument what you ship: Datadog RUM for errors and performance, PostHog for product analytics, feature flags, and experiments, and Google Tag Manager for marketing measurement, all respecting each customer's consent choices. Improve Core Web Vitals, bundle size, and rendering performance on a high-traffic, revenue-critical funnel. Make accessibility a default: semantic markup, keyboard and screen reader support, and automated accessibility checks in CI. Write automated tests at the right level: Vitest and Testing Library for components, MSW for API mocking, and Playwright for end-to-end booking flows. Own outcomes in production: ship behind feature flags, watch the dashboards after release, and follow through when something breaks. You are accountable for whether a feature works for customers, not just whether it merged. Partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Backend engineers, contributing to our shared component library and agreeing the API contracts the frontend depends on. Provide technical guidance through design discussions and high-quality code review, and mentor junior engineers. Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully as part of a structured build, review, and test workflow. What You’ll Bring Typically 4+ years of professional frontend engineering experience, including at least 3 years building production applications with React and TypeScript. Strong experience with Next.js or a comparable React framework, including server-side rendering, routing, and the tradeoffs between server and client rendering. Deep understanding of browser fundamentals: semantic HTML, modern CSS and responsive layout, the event loop, network and caching behavior, and the rendering pipeline. Experience with modern data-fetching and state management patterns (TanStack Query, Zustand, Redux, or similar) and with complex, validated, multi-step forms. Strong testing practices across unit, component, and end-to-end layers, using tools such as Vitest or Jest, Testing Library, and Playwright or Cypress. Experience building checkout, payment, or other transactional flows where correctness and reliability matter. Working knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) and web performance (Core Web Vitals). Experience with frontend observability and product analytics tools such as Datadog RUM, Sentry, PostHog, or Google Analytics. Hands-on experience with modern CI/CD practices and cloud hosting (for example GitHub Actions and AWS). A track record of leading complex features from design through production. A startup mindset: comfortable taking on ambiguous work, knowing when to pull in a second opinion on an approach, and able to balance speed with quality. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering, design, and business teams. Nice to Have Experience with Stripe.js and payment method integrations, including buy now, pay later providers such as Affirm. Experience with headless commerce platforms such as commercetools, or promotion engines such as Voucherify. Experience with Tailwind CSS and building on top of a design system or component library. Experience with consent management platforms (such as OneTrust), Google Tag Manager, and privacy-aware analytics. Experience with multi-region products: multiple currencies and locales, and correct date, time, and timezone handling. Growth engineering experience: working on a team that owns acquisition, activation, or conversion metrics, and shipping many small experiments quickly. Experience with funnel analytics and marketing attribution: event tracking plans, UTM and referral attribution, and conversion tracking into ad platforms such as Google Ads and Meta. Experience building growth surfaces such as landing pages, email capture, referral programs, promo codes, and abandoned-cart recovery. Experience with authentication and identity providers such as Auth0. Experience with scheduling, booking, or consumer healthcare applications, or working in highly regulated industries. Our Values First: we are Pioneers Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding. Second: we are Platform-Builders We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission. Above all: we are Patients We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work. What We Offer An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it We now offer the Prenuvo ’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Description: Senior Software Engineer, Front End – Dashboard About Caliza Caliza is commercial banking infrastructure for companies that operate across borders. Most global businesses still piece together several banks, FX providers and spreadsheets to move money. Caliza replaces that with one platform and API: hold USD accounts, collect and pay in 33+ currencies, and convert between fiat and stablecoins, over local rails, SWIFT or stablecoins, in minutes instead of days. On top of that, we’re building the treasury layer: programmable accounts, approval policies, automated reconciliation and working capital, run by a customer’s finance team or their AI agents. Our customers are importers, exporters, FX brokers, payment companies and fintechs across the Americas, Europe, Africa and Asia. We’re licensed and regulated across our core markets, and our team has built financial infrastructure at Visa, Nubank, EBANX, Flutterwave, Upstart, Intuit and Silicon Valley Bank. Our backers Initialized Capital, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Abstract Ventures, New Form Capital, QED Investors, Valor Capital and Quona Capital, along with the founders of Flutterwave, Chipper Cash, Rappi, Pomelo, Dock, Remesa Online and Anchorage. About the role The Caliza dashboard is where our customers see and control money moving across rails, currencies and countries. When a payment is in flight, a balance changes, or a compliance check is pending, the dashboard has to show it accurately and immediately, even across thousands of transactions. As a Senior Software Engineer focused on the dashboard, you'll own features end to end, including transaction and settlement views, balances across currencies, search and filtering, exports and reporting, and the permissions that control who sees and does what. You'll work closely with design, product, back-end and compliance. Location: Remote, open to candidates based in Latin America. Professional English required. In your first six months, you'll Design and build the real-time dashboard experience, so customers see payment and balance changes as they happen. Make large transaction tables fast and usable, with solid filtering, search and export. Improve how we show payment and settlement state, so users always know where money is and what happens next. Strengthen our shared component library and set front-end conventions for testing, performance and accessibility. What you'll be doing Build and maintain the dashboard in TypeScript and React. Design data-dense interfaces: tables, detail views, charts and reports. Integrate with back-end APIs, handling the loading, error and edge-case states that matter when money is involved. Contribute to our back-end services in Kotlin and Spring Boot when a feature needs it, such as adding or changing the APIs the dashboard depends on. Implement role-based access so each user sees exactly what they should. Own performance, from rendering large data sets to efficient data fetching. Write meaningful automated tests and review your teammates' code. Work with product and design from early concept through launch. What we're looking for 5+ years of professional front-end development experience. Deep expertise in TypeScript and React. Experience with data fetching, caching and state management tools such as Redux Toolkit and TanStack Query. Experience building real-time interfaces (websockets, live updates). Comfort working across the stack: you're happy to make back-end changes when a feature needs them. Experience building data-heavy applications such as dashboards, admin tools or analytics products. Strong product sense: you care about building rich, highly usable interfaces, not just shipping tickets. A strong grasp of front-end security: handling sensitive data, XSS/CSRF protection, and secure authentication flows. Real experience writing automated tests and caring about test quality. Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development in your daily work, with the judgment to review and question what the tools produce. Solid understanding of performance and accessibility (WCAG). Comfort with high autonomy and ambiguity in a fast-moving, remote startup. Clear written communication. Most of our collaboration is async. Nice to have Experience in fintech, payments, banking or crypto products. Back-end experience with Kotlin or Java and Spring Boot. Experience building or maintaining a design system. Experience with multiple currencies, languages, and number and date formats. How we work We use AI coding tools every day and expect you to as well. Description: As an engineer at Bask you will work directly with the CEO and CTO to build and design the software infrastructure that will serve as the backbone of telehealth. We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit. Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo — Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point. Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment — because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage. We are looking for engineers who take end-to-end ownership, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building software that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered. What You'll Do Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code — we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way. Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team. Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands. Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing — especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters. Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship. Make automation legible and trustworthy. Build systems that clearly communicate what AI and automation are doing on behalf of patients and providers. Earn trust through transparency, reliability, and thoughtful defaults. Champion performance, accessibility, and reliability. Ship work that is fast, robust, and accessible. Partner across the team to debug, optimize, and raise the bar over time. Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes. We are a highly collaborative team. Requirements A full-stack generalist who has taken a product from 0 to 1 and can apply that instinct inside a system that already has real patients on it. Entrepreneurial, willing to roll up their sleeves, and drawn to a mission that disrupts how healthcare gets delivered. 6+ Years of experience You are dangerous on the frontend of the stack. You are a highly skilled dev (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind and JavaScript). You also have backend skills (tRPC, Drizzle ORM, SQL, Node, SST). You can work independently and are comfortable owning entire projects or large areas of the codebase. Strong experience building paid products and services is preferred. React Native or Expo experience is a plus. You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate technical problems, constraints, and timelines. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured, startup environment. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: About ActAI There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations. Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things. Role As a Backend Engineer, AI, you own the inference and orchestration layer that powers every AI interaction in the product. Your work sits between models and users, where latency, correctness, reliability, and cost directly impact real-world experience. You will build and operate production systems that turn model capability into fast, stable, observable APIs used across mobile and desktop clients. Focus Build and operate backend systems that serve AI-powered features in production. Design inference pipelines, orchestration layers, and service boundaries around models. Own production concerns: monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response. Optimize latency and throughput across inference, caching, batching, and streaming. Ideal Experiences Strong backend engineering fundamentals in production environments. Experience running high-throughput, low-latency services. Familiarity with AI inference patterns (LLMs, embeddings, multimodal). Comfortable debugging distributed systems under load. Bias toward shipping and learning from production behavior. Outcomes Backend systems run reliably at scale, handling production AI traffic with low latency and high throughput. APIs are stable, clear, and support seamless integration with frontend and ML systems. Production incidents are quickly detected, diagnosed, and resolved, minimizing user impact. Iterative improvements based on real usage continuously increase system performance and reliability. Tech Stack Python NodeJs Pytorch OpenAI / Anthropic / open-source LLMs SQl & noSQL Kubernetes Docker How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product Interview process If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews. Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: At Midas , we tackle real-world engineering challenges to reshape the future of finance. Our mission is to build the fastest and most reliable products, delivering a seamless experience that empowers everyone to manage their money effortlessly. More than 3.5 million users use our product. Backed by an $80M Series B , the largest fintech investment ever in Turkey, we are scaling faster than ever. Read Before You Apply 🚨 This role is not for everyone. We are looking for outlier engineers who: Have owned products end-to-end , from idea to production monitoring. Have managed live incidents , written post-mortems, and implemented long-term fixes. Passionate about delivering exceptional product experiences and maximizing user impact , beyond just writing code. Years of experience don’t matter — what matters is the depth of ownership, incident handling, and product impact you’ve delivered. If this doesn’t sound like you, no worries — Midas has other opportunities that may be a better fit. What You’ll Do Build high performance, low latency, scalable web application for real-time trading and financial data. Investigate and solve complex engineering problems across the frontend, APIs, and real-time data flows. Contribute to technical decisions and continuously improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of the platform. Collaborate closely with product, design, backend, and other engineering teams to build and evolve Atlas. What We’re Looking For Strong fundamentals and a solid understanding of the challenges involved in building reliable, performant web applications. Good problem solving and debugging skills, with a willingness to dig into unfamiliar or complex problems. A willingness to take ownership, learn quickly, and grow with the product and the team. An interest in how engineering decisions affect performance, reliability, and user experience. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Nice to have Up to 5 years of professional software engineering experience. Experience building applications with React, Next.js, Redux, REST or GraphQL. Experience with real-time systems and high frequency data updates using technologies such as WebSockets or SSE. Familiarity with financial systems, trading platforms, or market data. Experience with browser performance profiling and optimization. How We Work Full ownership — you don’t wait, you solve. First principles mindset — you question assumptions and rebuild where needed. Balance speed & quality — you ship fast, but always clean. Product mindset — you care about the user impact, not just the code. Calm under pressure — incidents happen; you lead with clarity and composure. We don’t measure success by how many features you ship — but by the impact your work has on millions of users . If you thrive in high-stakes environments, love solving real problems, and own your work end-to-end, we want to meet you. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: About Block Labs Block Labs is a premier technology studio operating at the bleeding edge of Web3, Artificial Intelligence, and iGaming . We don't just ship features; we engineer high-scale, production-grade platforms that power the next generation of digital products. We are a collective of senior engineers, product strategists, and builders who refuse to compromise on architecture. Whether we are designing autonomous multi-agent AI systems, building decentralized financial infrastructure, or architecting high-frequency iGaming platforms, our standard is excellence. We move fast, but we build for the long term. If you are looking to work alongside a team that values deep technical expertise, thoughtful system design, and product ownership, Block Labs is where you belong. The role We are building the frontend of a multi-brand consumer platform in React, Next.js and TypeScript: one codebase serving several brands, where launching a brand should be a matter of configuration, not a copy. You will be the most senior frontend engineer in the company and the person the platform’s UI depends on. We don’t hire into squads. We work as a small number of very strong individual contributors, each owning a product end to end and shipping with AI agents at a pace that used to take a team. You get an outcome and constraints, not a backlog: you find the decisions nobody has made, scope the work, build it, ship it and stay accountable for how it behaves in production. Product ideas often arrive as working prototypes built with AI tools by people outside engineering. Your job is to steer them into production, not to reject them or rebuild them from zero. Key Responsibilities: Own the frontend end to end: architecture, conventions, quality bar and production behaviour of a multi-brand platform, with no spec handed to you. Make adding a brand a configuration change: theming, brand-aware routing and content, and clean boundaries between shared and brand-specific code, all on a live product. Build and own the design system and component library that engineers, designers and AI-assisted prototyping all draw from. Turn product prototypes into production features fast, and build the workflow and tooling that make this repeatable. Ship with AI coding agents every day as your main way of working, with the checks that keep quality high at agent speed, and raise the bar for how others use them. Ship consumer-facing UI with real attention to detail, performance and accessibility. Take UX and product concerns straight to the people who own the product, with alternatives and working examples, not just objections. About You: 8+ years building production consumer-facing web applications, several of them at Staff or equivalent ownership. You have taken a frontend from a rough brief to production and owned it, and you can say exactly what was yours, what was your team’s and what was your agents’. AI coding agents are how you build, not a helper. You have your own setup and can say precisely where agents make you faster, where they produce plausible but wrong output, and how you catch it. Deep expertise in React, Next.js and modern TypeScript, with clear opinions on rendering strategies and when each is the wrong choice. Hands-on experience building or re-architecting multi-brand, multi-tenant or white-label frontends. You have built or owned a design system and can discuss consistency versus flexibility, adoption and governance. Strong UI and UX sensibility: you notice the small things and fix them without being asked. Comfortable working with non-engineers who build with AI tools, and you design for their output to be usable. Demonstrable Core Web Vitals work in production. You thrive with autonomy and light process, and you write clearly. Strong command of written and verbal English. Nice to have Experience with real-time, high-interaction consumer interfaces where latency and feel matter. Background in fintech, crypto, real-time gaming and entertainment platforms, or other high-traffic consumer products. Tooling, skills or integrations you built so agents work better inside a specific codebase or design system. Working knowledge of CI/CD and cloud environments. What this role is not Not a management or lead role. Influence comes from what you ship. Not a pure architecture role. You write production code every day. Not for someone who wants a team, a backlog or a complete spec before starting. What kind of culture can I expect? Mature, mission-driven, and low-ego. We value clarity over noise, outcomes over theatrics, and pace without chaos. If you’re one of the smartest minds in your craft and want to build with other experts, you’ll feel at home here. Description: TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity! The work: We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982. This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds. Who we hire — the DNA Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals. Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama. Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread. AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity. Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands. Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them. You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we. Description: About Rivet Rivet is an AI-native accounting company. In less than 3 years, we've built a T500 accounting company in the US, combining corporate and personal income tax, sales tax, R&D credits, and bookkeeping into a single, all-inclusive experience that eliminates the worst parts of tax season for real businesses and the people who run them. Our platform is designed to feel invisible: it guides clients through their tax to-dos, automates the drudgery for preparers, and gets out of the way when it's not needed. We measure success in time saved and returns completed, not vanity usage metrics. We run Rivet (the business) on Rivet (the platform) because owning the stack makes it possible to deeply embed AI into every step of our workflows, far more than our competition will ever be able to relying on third-party/off-the-shelf tooling. Our team of 75 supports more than 1,300 clients, including some of the most innovative companies in the US — Cursor, Cognition, and ModRetro — and their executives, investors, and employees. And while we may have just gotten started a little over two years ago, this isn't our first rodeo: Nick Abouzeid (cofounder & CEO) comes from Ramp, where he ran three of their Growth teams from $100M → $600M in ARR Kyle Christenson (cofounder & Head of Tax) comes from the IRS, where he spent six years as an auditor before leaving to start his own firm over a decade ago We're well-funded, growing quickly, and sustainable. We've raised over $7M to date, from investors like XYZ Ventures, Susa Ventures, Haystack Ventures, and 40+ executives from Ramp, Anduril, Physical Intelligence, & more. Why this role is different The product is the only part of tax season most of our clients ever see, and it runs through one design engineer today. Every module's back-end owner pairs with him on the UI, which makes him the shared dependency for every screen we ship. You'd be the second, and the two of you would split it. Ownership from first commit to production. Engineers design, build, ship, and maintain their work — no handoffs, no middle-management mazes. Decisions happen at the edge. Engineers talk to clients and tax preparers directly. We optimize for speed and context, not committee consensus. Clear is kind. We surface problems early, talk about tradeoffs openly, and don't sugarcoat. We're kind by being honest, not by being vague. Pragmatic stacks. We pick tools that solve real problems. If it doesn't help us ship faster, safer, or better, we don't use it. Skin in the game. We ship things we'd be proud to put our name on — and if something breaks, we own it and fix it fast. Our stack Six engineers today, four languages. You'd live mostly in the first two: Frontend: React and TanStack, deployed to Cloudflare Workers. Typed clients generated from protobuf. Platform: Go, as a modular monolith — Connect RPC over protobuf, Go Fx for wiring, sqlc and goose against Postgres, River Pro for background jobs, Watermill for pub-sub over RabbitMQ. AI and eval: Python, in their own repos — ModelBridge (a gRPC service for AI building blocks) and TaxBench, our internal eval suite. Legacy integration: a C# Windows agent that drives Drake, one of the tax platforms our industry never built APIs for. Infrastructure: AWS — ECS Fargate, Amazon MQ, AMP, Loki, Tempo — provisioned by Pulumi, itself written in Go. Around the edges: Buildkite for CI, OpenTelemetry throughout, Doppler for secrets, Linear for tracking. What you'll do Drive on our client-facing surface area end to end — the portal where clients hand over documents, answer questions, and watch a return move toward filed. Design, build, ship, and keep it working. Build the workspace our preparers live in all day. Roughly 75 accountants use our internal tooling for eight hours a day, four months a year. Speed and clarity are the whole product for them. Work closely with Anton, our design engineer, and the rest of our engineering team. Back-end isn't off-limits - you'll have the ability to build and influence how our entire product is built from end-to-end. Ship AI into the interface, not around it. Extraction, review, and suggestion flows only work if the UI makes it obvious what the model did and where a human needs to look. Talk to the people using it. Accountants are in our Slack; clients are one call away. Watch someone use what you built before you decide it's done. We're fully distributed — but if you want an office, we'll help you find one through our investor network. What makes you a fit 6+ years building production web applications, primarily in React Have owned a product surface end to end, including the parts after launch Can read and write enough backend code to unblock yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting Care about the unglamorous parts — loading states, error handling, what happens on a bad connection with a 40MB PDF Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, early-stage environment Excellent verbal and written communication skills Nice to haves Production experience with TanStack (Query, Router, Table) Deployed to the edge — Cloudflare Workers or similar Worked with generated clients from protobuf, gRPC, or Connect RPC Built document-heavy or upload-heavy interfaces, where files are large, messy, and occasionally encrypted Strong design sense, especially if you've shipped without a dedicated designer Built internal tools for operators who sit close enough to tell you what's broken Built tax-adjacent software — fund administration, payroll, accounting platforms, filing systems, anywhere a wrong number has consequences What we offer Benefits and meaningful equity A fully remote team, plus twice-yearly company offsites A well-funded, fast-moving environment with minimal layers of management A world-class client base that values your time and pays for the premium experience The chance to build production-grade software your teammates use and love every day We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box. Originally posted on Himalayas
