Description: BackerKit helps creators bring projects to life. For over a decade, we’ve powered some of the world’s most successful crowdfunding campaigns. We’re always building the next generation of our platform, innovating, and driving the industry forward. We’re a remote-first company of ~40 people with a diverse, close-knit team that prizes creativity, enthusiasm, and a willingness to learn. We move quickly, think deeply about our users, and care about building software that lasts. We’re looking for a full-time, Staff-level engineer who is deeply motivated by user experience, interaction design, and frontend craftsmanship and excited to bring that to life within a Ruby on Rails monolith. Perhaps this is you! The role This is a hands-on fullstack, product engineering role reporting to our Director of Engineering, Product, and Design. You’ll lead mainly through the code you write, review, and ship, and most of your week should be devoted to the team’s queue. We are looking for a UX- and business-minded engineer to work directly in Rails views to simplify complex workflows, create intuitive user experiences, and help transform the crowdfunding landscape. You’ll help shape frontend patterns across the product, and turn our powerful, interconnected systems into intuitive experiences that are fast, clear, and approachable. This role is high-context, high-collaboration, and high-impact. You’ll evolve patterns, raise the quality bar through mentorship and code review, and influence how the entire Engineering, Product & Design team thinks about user experience. Everyone at BackerKit is customer-facing, and we expect everyone to get to know the creators and backers that we serve (plus, they are awesome, just like you!). How we build We iterate quickly, ship small experiments, and learn from customers. We use Claude Code, practice TDD, work in one-week iterations, and ship multiple times a day. We were a full-time pairing shop for over a decade, and pairing is still central to how we work. Right now we’re also experimenting with solo and cross-functional trio work as we figure out what a great product team looks like when everyone is also working alongside AI. Today we pair with intent: for complex or ambiguous work, knowledge transfer, onboarding, and a teammate’s growth. That balance is still evolving and may shift back toward more pairing, so we want someone who’s curious about how the team works today before helping us decide what comes next. We’re pragmatic. Speed matters, but it isn’t a goal on its own; we want a pace we can sustain while still doing quality work and shipping the most impactful features for our business. Crowdfunding has real urgency and some chaos, so built into our values is the ability to respond quickly when creators, backers, and colleagues need us. Our process keeps evolving, and we want your voice in it. As one of our most senior folks, you’ll bring strong opinions and your experience to those conversations. We’re highly collaborative, but we aren’t purely consensus-driven. BackerKit is a Ruby on Rails “majestic monolith” deployed on Heroku. The codebase has been around since 2012. Despite that, it is relatively well-factored and well-tested. We’ve been tending this garden for over a decade! We value simplicity, maintainability, communication, and shared ownership. We’re a remote-first team, and this role works the team’s shared hours, 9-5 Pacific. We work closely with teammates across the company and with the creators and backers we serve, so being reachable and ready to respond to what the day brings during those hours matters. What you’ll do Build alongside engineers, PMs, and designers in pairs, trios and solo, working on the most impactful features as we innovate the crowdfunding landscape Lead frontend architecture, evolving patterns incrementally from real, repeated cases Co-own features end to end, translating product and design intent into elegant, maintainable UI and following up on usage after launch Simplify complex workflows and improve usability, responsiveness, and performance Mentor engineers and set the bar for code quality through review, holding AI-generated code to a high standard Report to our Director and join their engineering leadership group, alongside our other Staff Engineer and our CEO (a founding engineer who still codes daily), to advise on priorities and shape technical direction. Carry your share of team rotations, including on-call, PR review, and meeting host, and take actual breaks and vacations, with no off-hours or weekend work required beyond your on-call shifts What we’re looking for Technical, craft, and process Deep experience building high-quality user interfaces, and recent hands-on coding Strong fundamentals in HTML, CSS, JS, and browser behavior Comfort working directly in Rails views, helpers, and partials Experience with or strong interest in Hotwire / Turbo / Stimulus Preference for simple, maintainable systems over unnecessary abstraction Values pairing, and genuine interest in exploring what that looks like in this new AI-enabled world (bonus if you’ve worked in a 100% pairing environment) Product & UX thinking Strong product and interaction design instincts Experience simplifying complex workflows Ability to work effectively with ambiguity Staff-level impact Experience shaping engineering patterns and conventions Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills Act as a go-to partner for complex or ambiguous frontend and UX challenges Ability to zoom out to systems (architecture and business-level) thinking while remaining comfortable bushwhacking in the weeds Comfort making your case on priorities, then committing to the decision once it’s made. Most successful candidates for this role have 10+ years of software development experience working on multiple complex software projects over time and 5+ years as a staff engineer, though we do not have a strict years-of-experience requirement. This role is a great fit if you Have deep knowledge of Ruby, Rails, and JavaScript Care deeply about how software feels to use Enjoy working across product, design, and backend concerns Prefer cohesive Rails applications over fragmented frontend stacks or SPAs Treat constraints as a creative tool Care about creators getting to make a living doing what they love This role is likely not a fit if you Prefer working in React, Vue, or SPA-heavy environments Prefer fully decoupled frontend/backend architectures Prefer long periods of solo or heads-down work Prefer to set your own priorities rather than work from a shared team queue Are looking for a part-time or contract role Compensation & benefits Full-time, salaried, remote-first position on a distributed team Competitive salary and stock option plan Medical, dental, vision, and 401k benefits (with employer match!) Stipends for supporting creators of your choosing Annual Learning and Development stipend to support your professional growth Family-friendly and focused on maintaining a healthy work/life balance Awesome work environment at a company with a huge opportunity Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet ~60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented groups tend to only apply when they check every box. Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world. Description: Type: Full-time contractor Location: Remote (Europe/Africa time zones) Language: Fluent, professional-level English Travel: None expected OpenFn is a Digital Public Good for public service automation and AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and workflows, helping governments and NGOs connect fragmented systems and deliver essential services across health, humanitarian response, and government programmes. Open Function Group, the platform’s primary steward, is a small, fully remote team of engineers, integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 15+ countries. We build infrastructure that helps governments function, clinics operate, and people access the services they depend on. The role Connecting two government systems should get easier every time. Today, it often means starting again: negotiating access, configuring environments, and deciding who can trust whom. Each new connection becomes another project. We’re hiring a Staff Back-End Engineer to help change that. You’ll join our Connections squad, with a clear mission: make it dramatically cheaper for government departments to collaborate. Your work will turn the hard parts of each integration into capabilities teams can use again and again. You’ll define how organisations connect their systems and share credentials, and build the workers that execute their workflows reliably at scale. As OpenFn grows to support everything around those workflows, from setup to monitoring and reporting, you’ll contribute significantly to the architectural direction of our backend. You’ll have the opportunity to make substantial technical contributions and the responsibility to see them through. Most of your time will be spent in the codebase, with design discussions, code review, and written proposals helping the team build on your work. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. Our stack is Elixir/Phoenix and Node.js. You’ll need Node.js experience; you can learn Elixir here. What you’ll do Ship production features Deliver features end to end, from technical proposal to production. Build the squad’s core capabilities: connected-system registration and governance, credential ownership and sharing, and high-performance workers that execute workflows reliably at scale. Shape OpenFn ’s backend architecture Set architectural direction across OpenFn ’s backend, including module boundaries, service interfaces, naming, and conventions. Establish consistent patterns that help engineers navigate and extend the codebase, including when using AI development tools. Set engineering conventions through code review, documentation, and your own work. Strengthen platform security Translate security findings into architectural changes and carry them through to production. Strengthen trust boundaries, isolation, and credential handling. Requirements What you’ll bring 8+ years of experience building and operating backend services for customer-facing products. Experience designing backend service architectures, not only extending existing ones. Experience building backend services with Node.js. Experience operating services where reliability and scale have direct consequences for users. The ability to work independently and collaborate across time zones in a small, distributed team, using GitHub, Slack, and written proposals. Clear, professional communication in English and the ability to work effectively across cultures. Useful additional experience Elixir/Phoenix or other languages and frameworks designed for functional programming or concurrency. Developer tooling or large migration programmes. Securing production systems. Work in health, humanitarian response, government digital transformation, or the wider social impact sector. Working proficiency in Spanish or French. Benefits Compensation and benefits Compensation based on experience, following OpenFn ’s Equal Pay for Equal Work framework. Our NGO and government customer base means we don’t offer Silicon Valley pay scales; we aim to provide fair, transparent, and competitive pay. Flexible working hours. Fully remote work, with team meetups across Europe and Africa. Our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar. Significant influence on the platform’s architecture and the opportunity to help shape our technical strategy. The opportunity to build open source software that helps ensure everyone worldwide can get access to great digital public services. Originally posted on Himalayas

Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Requirements Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Description: About the team Zillow is the top real estate website in the U.S., where millions of people come for help with their move. The hardest parts happen after the fun of browsing online, and the full process may span months. We empower home buyers by connecting them to the best professionals and tools to complete their move with confidence and ease. The Post-Connect Engineering org owns the stretch of the journey that starts when a home buyer requests to tour a home and ends when their offer is under contract. It's all too easy for a buyer to be overwhelmed by the details and daunted by finding "the one" that fits the must-haves and the budget. Our job is to make touring and triaging homes easy to do with other people, so that buyers remain energized and able to actually move. Our systems manage appointments against real-world constraints, sustain rich conversations across disparate channels and apps, and convert a buyer's raw reactions to homes into actionable plans, with AI running throughout. About the role You will primarily support five engineering teams and their partners in Product and Data Science on matters technical and strategic. You solve customer, business, and technical problems without authority over any team; your influence comes from the quality of your judgment and the relationships you cultivate. You will lead and mentor engineers across the organization and act as a domain expert and ambassador across Zillow Group . You will be the primary technical steward of the backend of the Post-Connect domain; it spans multiple languages, third-party integrations, and a distributed architecture running in AWS. But we are first and foremost a product engineering team, with customers as our north star. You choose where your effort will have the most leverage. You will take on the problems that are too large or too ambiguous for a single team to absorb. The job requires self-direction with occasional top-down assignments: there is no backlog curated for you. Success looks like framing a problem nobody has yet defined; asking tough questions to sharpen a plan; doing analysis that settles a build-versus-buy or an architecture decision; prototyping a new tool, pattern, or process yourself so the teams have a working exemplar to adopt; balancing your workload and delegating work that’s not essential for you to do. There’s plenty of ambiguity here, but also tremendous opportunity to improve how people buy and sell homes! You will get to Define and drive the long-term technical strategy and architecture for back-end platforms and services, ensuring they are scalable, secure, observable, and cost-efficient in a cloud-native environment. Lead design and implementation of high-throughput, low-latency APIs, data and event pipelines, and platform capabilities that support multiple Zillow brands, products, and machine learning workloads. Solve the most complex technical problems on the team, making high-impact design decisions, setting engineering standards, and de-risking ambiguous initiatives through prototyping, experimentation, and data-driven tradeoffs. Partner closely with product, data, and machine learning leaders to translate business goals into technical roadmaps, aligning cross-team dependencies and ensuring back-end systems enable great customer and partner experiences. Mentor and coach senior engineers and tech leads, elevating engineering practices in areas such as reliability, performance, testing, incident response, and operational excellence across multiple teams. Influence platform and data governance, security, and compliance practices, helping define guidelines, reviews, and guardrails that keep systems resilient and protect customer and partner data at scale. Champion a culture of continuous improvement by driving adoption of modern back-end technologies, tooling, and workflows that improve developer experience, reduce friction, and increase delivery speed and quality. Experience leading large-scale, highly available, and high-volume services or platforms, ideally in a cloud environment such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Experience providing technical leadership across teams or domains, including setting architectural direction, influencing roadmaps, and driving complex initiatives from concept to production. Or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Get to know us At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. Description: NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within EMEA to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within EMEA. Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth. Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here. About the role We are looking for a delivery-focused Staff Backend Engineer to build our new 0-1 Trust Accounting subsystem . This is a greenfield opportunity to design and deliver a financial system that property managers can trust—one that is accurate, compliant, and reliable. You will have a significant impact on shaping the financial operations of Hostaway 's customers, allowing them to maintain compliant records and properly manage funds. As a founding member of this new team, you will be responsible for the architecture and technical direction of this critical platform. You’ll influence architecture, processes, and delivery from day one, establishing a culture where correctness and accountability are paramount. Your work will directly determine how effectively Hostaway can deliver secure and auditable financial services to our customers. What You’ll Do Architect a Greenfield System: Lead the greenfield development, owning the architecture and technical vision for the V1 Trust Accounting product. Build Production-Grade Financial Infrastructure: Design and implement the core backend services for a secure, scalable, and auditable trust accounting subsystem with the highest quality standards. Drive Quality and Reliability: Establish quality gates, robust testing, and CI/CD integration to ensure every feature ships with measurable confidence and correctness. Champion Engineering Best Practices: Drive best practices for system design, observability, and security across the organization, with a focus on quality, resilience, and financial accuracy. Collaborate and Influence: Work closely with product, design, finance, and legal teams to deliver a seamless product. Provide technical context in discussions to foster transparency and accountability. Mentor and Elevate Engineers: Raise the technical bar across the team and beyond through code reviews, architectural guidance, and hands-on pairing. Requirements 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years operating at a Staff Engineer or equivalent level. Backend Expertise: High proficiency in a backend language for building production-grade services. Production Experience: You've built, shipped, and operated critical backend systems that serve real users at scale. You understand the operational realities of reliability, observability, and failure modes. Strong Architectural Instincts: You can design systems that start simple and evolve gracefully, making pragmatic trade-offs between speed and extensibility. Cross-Team Influence: You lead through clarity and credibility, not authority, and have successfully driven the adoption of platforms, patterns, or standards. Infrastructure Fluency: Comfortable with AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and operating services in production. Polyglot Comfort: You have the curiosity and adaptability to integrate with code across these technologies. Nice to have: Experience with Accounting or Ledger Products: Familiarity with financial systems, accounting principles, or ledger products is a significant plus. Backend expertise: hands on production experience with Golang. What Success Looks Like The Trust Accounting subsystem is delivered reliably, is trusted by customers and regulators, and integrates seamlessly into the Hostaway platform. The system is high-throughput and low-error, providing accurate, auditable data to customers. Financial correctness and compliance are central to the product's design and operation. You become a go-to technical authority for financial systems and backend architecture at Hostaway . The platform scales to meet growing demand without requiring a fundamental re-architecture. What we offer Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant. 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one). Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success. Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions. Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities. Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms. Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant. Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here). Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied. Description: At Affirm , we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm ’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering. About the role As a Senior Software Engineer on Loan Origination and Reporting, you’ll build and scale the data platforms and services that process loan originations in real time and deliver accurate reporting to Affirm and its financial partners, strengthening the core financial engine behind transparent, reliable ways to pay over time. What you’ll do You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery. You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs. You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them. You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts. You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. What we look for You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes. You have deep expertise in designing and operating scalable backend data pipelines and batch processing systems using Spark, Airflow, or similar distributed frameworks. You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others. You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely. · Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders. You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team. This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Base Pay Grade- N Equity Grade- 9 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.) USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $195,000 - $255,000 USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $173,000 - $233,000 Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm 's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described. An overview of this role As a Senior Backend Engineer, Performance Enablement, you'll make performance testing and analysis easier for engineering teams to adopt and own. You'll build platforms, tooling, guidance, and artificial intelligence-assisted workflows that help teams identify performance risks during development and before they roll changes out to production. We're moving from a hands-on consulting model to a self-service model. Service teams own their performance tests, analysis, thresholds, and evidence. We provide the paved road, documentation, skills, and expert support for challenging problems and new capabilities. This is a backend and platform engineering role with room to grow in scope and influence. You'll help shape how Performance Enablement supports engineering teams, using artificial intelligence thoughtfully to accelerate design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and automation. You'll support work such as: Enabling modular feature teams, including Orbit and Artifact Registry, to run performance testing through their own development and continuous integration workflows Building reusable performance tooling, including component-level testing, load testing, performance analysis, and artificial intelligence-assisted engineering skills Improving performance results, reporting, and trend visibility so teams can make informed decisions from their own evidence Establishing the documentation, templates, and guidance needed to expand self-service adoption across research and development What you’ll do Build and evolve reusable backend platforms and tooling for performance testing and analysis. Create self-service workflows, documentation, templates, diagnostics, and artificial intelligence skills that reduce the need for bespoke support. Use development practices that apply artificial intelligence to accelerate implementation, testing, debugging, and technical documentation. Influence engineering teams to make performance testing part of normal development and release preparation. Turn early hands-on engagements into generalized capabilities that many teams can adopt independently. Provide technical expertise for difficult performance questions, tooling enhancements, and new platform capabilities. What you’ll bring Experience building backend or platform software. Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing tooling. Experience partnering with development teams to improve their day-to-day workflows. Experience using development practices that apply artificial intelligence across the software lifecycle. Experience with software performance, such as performance analysis, optimization, benchmarking, or leading performance-related improvements. Practical experience with Kubernetes, k6, and Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform, or similar cloud infrastructure. Experience building durable solutions that support broad adoption using systems thinking. Communicate clearly in writing and influence teams without direct authority. About the team Performance Enablement is part of Platform Enablement within Developer Experience and Infrastructure Platforms. We help GitLab teams make performance part of the software lifecycle. Our goal is to make performance a shared responsibility of service-owning teams while providing a strong platform and center of expertise when teams need help. We work asynchronously, collaborate broadly across research and development, and focus on building capabilities that scale beyond individual team engagements. Description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users. What You'll Own Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows. Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products. Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms. Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling. Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely. Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes. What We're Looking For Strong backend engineering experience in production systems. Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations. Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale. Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset. Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability. Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks. People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk. Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements. Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems. People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: Description MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare clinic setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi 's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality. We're looking for a Senior Backend (NodeJS) Engineer to join our AI Automation team and lead the development of AI-driven integrations within our telemedicine platform. You will design and scale the backend systems that connect our core product with AI services, directly improving how thousands of patients and providers interact with MEDvidi every day. You'll work at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, building production-grade systems that automate clinical and operational workflows. You'll collaborate closely with AI engineers, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ship reliable, scalable automation, from multi-agent orchestration to RAG pipelines. Responsibilities Design and build backend architecture for AI-powered automation systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and resilience. Integrate and scale LLM-based product features in close collaboration with AI engineers and product teams. Implement and evolve agent-based systems (e.g., ReAct, supervisor-agent models) supporting complex decision-making flows. Optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and context enrichment using structured and unstructured data. Develop robust APIs for internal services and external integrations. Ensure strong observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using tools like Grafana and OpenSearch. Participate in code reviews, contribute to architecture discussions, and maintain high-quality technical documentation for newly designed systems and APIs. Requirements 8+ years of commercial backend development with Node.js in product companies (preferably SaaS), with deep understanding of complex backend systems end-to-end. Strong experience designing backend architectures and technical solutions, including system decomposition, scalability trade-offs, long-term maintainability, and technology choices. Proven track record building scalable, high-performance backend systems and robust APIs, with solid understanding of data flows, failure modes, and performance bottlenecks. Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (not demos), with focus on reliability, predictability, cost control, and measurable quality improvements. Experience designing and implementing multi-agent AI workflows in production, including orchestration logic, ReAct patterns, supervisor-agent architectures, and clear understanding of when such approaches are justified. Practical experience with modern AI frameworks Solid experience designing and optimizing RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, ranking, chunking, and quality vs. latency trade-offs. Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured outputs (JSON/YAML), schema validation, evaluation-based iteration (e.g., AI eval frameworks), and reliability techniques beyond prompt-only solutions. Understanding of LLM infrastructure in production environments: tracing and observability (LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar), evaluation frameworks and quality metrics, tooling and orchestration, safety mechanisms and guardrails, performance and cost optimization. Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, performance optimization) and AWS (CDK, Lambda, API Gateway, ElastiCache). Good understanding of observability and debugging (Grafana, OpenSearch, or similar). Strong engineering culture: testing, CI/CD, reliability, and technical ownership. Product-oriented mindset with the ability to build user-centered automation, not isolated technical components. Proactive AI enthusiast mindset: explores and validates new AI approaches and patterns applicable to product use cases. Fluent Russian; English B2+. Would be a plus Experience working with medical/healthcare AI or regulated environments. Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) in Node.js. What we offer High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space. Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package. Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model. Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports and wellness compensation. Career development: Personalized English lessons via Preply and clear growth paths. Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days. Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events. Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together. ﻿ MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Description: You'll build the software that connects engineering intelligence to the world's leading CAD platforms. If you've ever written Python that automated Siemens NX, CATIA, SOLIDWORKS, or Creo—or built backend services that process engineering design data—you'll likely find this work exciting. You'll design APIs, integrate CAD systems with cloud-native infrastructure, and build the backend powering AI-driven engineering workflows used to accelerate product design and manufacturing. This role combines software engineering, CAD automation, backend architecture and mechanical engineering in ways that are rarely found together ABOUT US: We are a MIT-born, venture-backed Silicon Valley startup building a real-life 'Jarvis'—an AI Copilot for design and manufacturing. Our goal is to utilize advanced AI, physics simulation, and computer graphics to reduce costs and improve engineering productivity across all steps of the design and manufacturing process. Responsibilities You'll help build systems that: Translate CAD models into machine-readable engineering data. Connect Siemens NX, CATIA, SOLIDWORKS and other CAD platforms with cloud-native AI services. Build scalable APIs that allow engineering applications to exchange geometry and metadata. Develop Python services that automate complex engineering workflows. Design backend systems that manage CAD assemblies, parts, configurations and engineering metadata. Partner with researchers building next-generation Engineering AI. What we're looking for BS/MS in Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering , or a related technical field. 5+ years of experience building and maintaining backend services and production software . Strong Python engineering skills with experience writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code . Experience developing software integrations using commercial CAD APIs , such as Siemens NX Open, CATIA, SOLIDWORKS API, Creo Toolkit, Autodesk Inventor API , or similar engineering platforms. Experience building cloud-native applications, backend APIs, and data models (including Protobuf). Experience working with 3D engineering data, CAD models, assemblies, and related engineering file formats . Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering, research, and product teams . You've built software using at least one commercial CAD API: Siemens NX Open CATIA SOLIDWORKS API Creo Toolkit Autodesk Inventor API Bonus Points Experience developing CAD automation tools, plugins or engineering software integrations. Familiarity with computational geometry, CAD workflows, PLM systems, or engineering data pipelines. Experience working with large-scale 3D models, assemblies or complex engineering datasets. Strong programming experience in C++ alongside Python. Experience designing and implementing gRPC-based APIs and distributed services. Experience building and deploying applications using Docker and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Experience implementing logging, monitoring, observability, and production debugging practices. Experience partnering with mechanical engineers, researchers, or AI/ML teams to build engineering applications. Passion for building software at the intersection of CAD, Mechanical Engineering, Backend Systems, and Engineering AI. Our tech stack Google Cloud Python, TypeScript Protobuf, gRPC , GitHub Actions Docker, Kubernetes, Spinnaker PostgreSQL Originally posted on Himalayas

Description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users. What You'll Own Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows. Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products. Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms. Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling. Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely. Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes. What We're Looking For Strong backend engineering experience in production systems. Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations. Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale. Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset. Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability. Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks. People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk. Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements. Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems. People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized. Originally posted on Himalayas
